opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any researcher based in the UK with some prior public engagement experience. Previous successful recipients are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: The SHAPE Involve and Engage programme offers up to £8,000 for humanities and social sciences researchers to engage the public with their research through innovative public engagement projects.

opportunities.opportunity_id: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: The symposium will bring together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to discuss the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future'.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The scheme is covered under the Full Economic Costing (FEC) regime.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: The British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowship offers outstanding early-career researchers the opportunity to strengthen their experience of research and teaching in an academic environment.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers with a current long-term appointment at a UK-based Higher Education Institution or Independent Research Organisation.
opportunities.summary: The Talent Development Awards support the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research institute.
opportunities.summary: The programme supports projects that engage with questions concerning the relationship between expertise, public understanding and policy delivery internationally.

opportunities.opportunity_id: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to early and mid-career researchers from the humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: The Global Innovation Fellowships provide opportunities for UK-based researchers to develop their skills, networks and careers in the creative, cultural, public, private and policy sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to current British Academy award-holders and applicants who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: The Additional Needs scheme provides funding to support specific needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment or assistance for sensory impairment.
